description:
Аbout   GlobalFoundries  
 GlobalFoundries is a world-leading contract manufacturer for the global semiconductor industry with facilities in Dresden, Singapore, New York and Vermont (USA). Our products are used in various technical applications, e.g. mobile communications, consumer electronics, automotive and more. GlobalFoundries employs around 13,000 people worldwide, including 300 in Sofia. 
 Our Sofia based team will enhance GF’s scale and capabilities, while strengthening competitiveness of its specialized application solutions to further position the company for growth and value creation. 
 Our Design and Technology Enablement teams are working on the development of a broad portfolio of semiconductor technologies ranging from 350 nm down to 12nm including FD-SOI, RF, High-Voltage, and automotive applications.
 
 Your Job   

 We are looking for candidates with a strong passion for software development and experienced in solving real world issues with automation flows. Fluent in coding with programming languages (JavaScript, Python, R-script). The candidate should be interested in custom tools development and infrastructure development, in addition, would like to build skills and expertise in advanced data analytics and machine learning     

   

 Responsibilities:   

 Develop new functionality and build tools to automate and improve efficiency of device engineering core tasks    

 
 Build and maintain data flows, database infrastructure to enable and support Big Data analytics projects for Device Engineering organization   

 
 Support deployment of Machine Learning (ML) projects in cloud environment for all Fabs    

 
 Contribute to software development of Global Device Engineering infrastructure efficiency and innovation projects: Define, generate, and maintain efficient coding in Python, JavaScript or R and other programming languages   

 
 Working with device engineering teams at Fab locations to improve automation for multiple job functions, building tracking dashboards     

 
 Integrate existing Device Engineering analysis tools and software with AWS cloud databases   

 
 Productize small scale application solutions for larger use and drive adoption / standardization across the Device Engineering organization    

 
 Customer focused approach to developing and delivering ad-hoc analysis applications    

 
 Collaborate across organizational boundaries within Technology Development and Design Enablement Teams, present project status to peers and the leadership team as needed   

 
 Able to handle multiple projects      

 

 Quick learner and team player in an international multi-disciplinary environment    

 
   

 Required Qualifications:     

 BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering with 3 years of experience   

 
 Expert level and industry experience in custom software development using Python, JavaScript or R-script.   

 
 Strong data analysis, data mining and problem-solving skills.      

 
 Experience with Cloud data technologies.   

 
 Experience with SQL or other databases.   

 
 Strong interpersonal skills; team player; able to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.      

 
 Excellent written and oral communications skills.     

 
 Understanding of semiconductor devices and process fabrication flow is a plus   

 
 
 We Offer 
 Attractive compensation package with competitive salary, performance related bonus plan and a global recognition program.

 Employee Stock Purchase Plan (including 20% match and 50 seed shares for first time participants, non-executive).

 Individual, technical or management career path opportunities supported by enhanced learning and development programs.

 Healthy and teambuilding work environment with various perks:
 Additional medical service, including dental and, coverage of employees’ children

 Food vouchers and canteen discounts

 Monthly budget for Flex benefit

 Top-rated office location with recreation Spa facilities

 Discounts for Spa & Wellness Programs at NV Tower

 Regular Team Events and Celebrations

 
 Focus on employee work-life balance:
 Hybrid working model and flexible working time

 21 to 25 days paid vacation depending on years with the company

 
 
 G lobal F oundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard.   

 As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities.   

 All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks , medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.   

 No Recruitment Fee Policy: GlobalFoundries is committed to ethical and transparent hiring practices. Candidates will not be charged any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. Any request for payment related to a GlobalFoundries employment opportunity is unauthorized and should be reported immediately . All legitimate recruitment communications are conducted exclusively through official GlobalFoundries channels. To report concerns or suspected recruitment fraud, please contact our Ethics & Compliance Office at global.compliance@GlobalFoundries.com or visit our official website.   

   

 The Ethics & Compliance mailbox is not a recruitment channel. CVs/resumes submitted to this mailbox will not be reviewed, processed, or considered for employment opportunities. Please apply through the official GlobalFoundries careers site only.   



 
 Information about our benefits you can find here: https://gf.com/careers/opportunities-in-europe/
